title: First-Expedite Courtesy on Ostomy Supply Program Refills
content:
A first-expedite courtesy reduces the Ostomy Supply Program charge for a refill shipped expedited at the customer's request, according to the program's refills shipped expedited in the last 12 months (ship date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today), counted together with this refill even when it shipped earlier than that.

| Refills of the program shipped expedited in the last 12 months | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| This refill is the only one | 10% (the larger courtesy) |
| Exactly two | 5% (the smaller courtesy) |
| Any other count | None |

The courtesy rate is taken off the fee.

**Cases (hypothetical).** First expedite of the year: 10%. A second expedite within 12 months: 5%. A third: none. A refill shipped expedited 14 months ago with no expedite since: counted together with itself, it is the only one, so 10%.
